map.纵坡 = 高差 / 平距 使用指南: Longitudinal Gradient = Height Difference / Horizontal Distance User Guide
map.输入两点间高差 h 与水平距离 d，按 坡度%=(h/d)×100 计算纵坡百分: Enter the height difference h and horizontal distance d between two points to compute the longitudinal gradient percentage from grade% = (h/d)×100, which can also be converted to a gradient angle, for road and pipeline grade design and site drainage.
map.由高差与水平距算坡度%。: Compute the grade % from the height difference and horizontal distance.
map.与角度互转。: Converts to and from the angle.
map.：高差 10m、水平距 100m → 坡度=10/100×100%=10%（约: : A height difference of 10 m over 100 m horizontal gives grade=10/100×100%=10% (about 5.71°).
map.：排水管坡 2%：每 100m 降 2m 保证自流，坡太小易淤、太大冲蚀。: : A drainage pipe gradient of 2% drops 2 m every 100 m to keep flow self-driven; too shallow silts up and too steep scours.
map.由横基尺长度与夹角求距离: Find the distance from the subtense bar length and the angle
map.由半径与转角求切线长: Find the tangent length from the radius and turn angle
map.坡度%=(高差/水平距)×100，分母是水平距不是斜距。: Grade %=(height difference / horizontal distance)×100; the denominator is the horizontal distance, not the slope distance.
map.10% 坡=坡比 1:10；坡比=水平:高差，互为倒数关系。: A 10% grade = a slope ratio of 1:10; the slope ratio is horizontal:vertical, and the two are reciprocals.
